title: YouTube Extended Search with FlashData
description: Enter your Key and required query input. Start performs one YouTube Extended Search request using your FlashData Credits.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Your own FlashData API key with YouTube Extended Search permission. Encrypted; no shared key is provided.

query.title: Query
query.description: A single search query or query prefix. No automatic query expansion.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Requested results. Actual count may be lower; extended search uses a separate rate.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional YouTube search filters as a JSON object. Use the documented fields and values.
